pages.notes: Cover page of Apollo 11 Technical Crew Debriefing is legible but OCR heavily corrupted strikethrough text, classification markings, handwritten annotations, and the bottom indexing table; core title and metadata partially captured.

Typewritten Apollo mission dialogue transcript with accurate main text; OCR errors include misplaced speaker names (listed at top rather than inline) and spurious end characters ('~ ol TL AL. ae') not present in original image.
Typewritten dialogue transcript with minor character substitution errors ('ii' for 'L', 'Lt.' for 'it.'); hand-stamped CONFIDENTIAL markings visible but don't significantly impede text extraction.

Pristine OCR capture of a declassified Apollo astronaut interview transcript discussing unidentified object observations; all dialogue and speaker attributions accurately transcribed from the well-preserved original document.

Dialogue transcript OCR captures nearly all text correctly but has errors: document ID shows '6-36' in OCR but image shows 'C-36', one instance of 'IM' instead of 'LM', and stray characters 'ST Ar b' at end. Clean scan with minor age-related staining.

Typewritten Apollo 11 declassified document; OCR captures nearly all text but contains two errors: 'During' misread as 'wae' in 'transearth coast' passage, and erroneous ':' inserted between lines, likely due to slight fading and typewriter font variations.

Typewritten government interview transcript with CONFIDENTIAL stamps; OCR accurately captures nearly all text but misreads '50' as '20' in the final line ('20 significant observations' should be '50').

Typewritten transcript of space mission observations (Aldrin/Armstrong dialogue) with clear scan quality; OCR errors include 'CONEIDENTIAT' for CONFIDENTIAL header, stray 'oo', and 'eould' for 'could', but body text is well captured.

NASA Apollo 11 Technical Crew Debriefing cover page from July 31, 1969 with heavy OCR degradation; major errors include 'SCONFDENTAL' for CONFIDENTIAL, 'APOLLO II' for APOLLO 11, and significant corruption of the body text and notice section.

Apollo mission transcript with CONFIDENTIAL markings; OCR fabricates header gibberish ("onesie = allele ee", malformed speaker labels), misreads "ascent" as "oe" in section 21.5, and "sort" as "SOT", but captures ~80% of actual body text accurately.

Declassified government transcript with CONFIDENTIAL stamps; OCR error in line 'probably a reflection off a lake' rendered as 'xp ChAbi e reflection off a: lake' suggests character recognition issue with that specific phrase.
